children: European markets started the week in the green, led by the financial and utilities sectors. The Europe-wide Stoxx 600 index was up 0.4% having closed the previous week higher and with Friday marking its largest one-day gain since Sept. 21. Germany's DAX was up 0.4%, led by Commerzbank and Deutsche bank, which were up 1.6% and 1.4% respectively. London's FTSE 100 index was up 0.6%, also boosted by banks with HSBC, Barclays and Lloyds up 2%, 1.55% and 1.5% respectively. France's CAC 40 was up 0.45%. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
